## Demo Content

This is placeholder content for testing the Projects page layout. It is not a real student submission.

Campus Pathfinder imagines a tool that recommends routes between campus buildings while accounting for elevator access, weather exposure, and estimated walking time.

![Route planning dashboard](images/route-dashboard.svg)
